name: OSR-Bench
description: OSR-Bench is a benchmark suite for evaluating open-set / out-of-distribution recognition performance across vision datasets and models. It measures how well classifiers can detect samples from unknown classes while maintaining accuracy on known classes, providing standardized datasets, protocols, and metrics for open-set evaluation. The benchmark focuses on robustness to novel classes and calibration of unknown detection scores.
evaluation_method: AUROC (area under ROC) and open-set accuracy / false positive rate at fixed threshold
reputation: A niche but useful resource in the open-set recognition and anomaly-detection research communities; cited in specialized robustness work.
